title: Not a genius. I just don't leave things *broken.*
subtitle: I might not be cracked, but I finish what I start.

details.context: GameFarm: a fleet of phones where AI agents play mobile games to collect competitor monetization data.
did: Rebuilt the game-playing agent's loop around the OpenAI Decisions API, combining screenshots and past actions into each decision.
Owned the GCP architecture across international device hubs.
Built a BigQuery pipeline ranking games by performance and monetization competitor, feeding Salesforce with target leads and mock Xsolla webshops to pitch migration.

influence.label: agent loop, 10 s → 2 s per move

details.context: A developer tool that catches breaking changes in third-party APIs, packages and SDKs, then drafts the fix as a pull request a human reviews.
did: Leading product: owning the vision, the roadmap and the business model.
Building the agentic system that detects breaking changes in third-party APIs, packages and SDKs.
Designing how it drafts human-reviewed pull requests in customers' repos.

details.context: Cloud-native IAM platform for a Tier-1 telecom, serving 130M+ subscribers at 36K TPS.
did: Rebuilt a reporting workflow with Claude Skills, MCP integrations and subagents, keeping engineers in the loop to review critical output.
Mapped undocumented CI/CD pipelines across 20 microservices.
Owned pipeline and Kubernetes cluster health for 5 releases, root-causing recurring failures like certificate flakiness and PVC deadlocks with permanent fixes.
Built a regression pipeline that runs Postman collections every release.
Replaced Selenium UI scraping with a direct Grafana REST API integration for performance reports.
Cleared a backlog of 20+ API performance tests across REST and Kafka event pipelines, tracing TPS regressions to their root commits.

influence.label: of pipeline and cluster health owned

details.context: Moving a company's entire code history off a failing legacy version control system.
did: Reverse-engineered the proprietary SDK of the legacy version control system.
Built extraction tooling on top of it that stayed within a 1.5 GB JVM limit.
Migrated the production code to Git.

influence.label: of production code moved to Git
